summary: Share WebSocket mission and attention projections across equivalent subscribers with exact clock validity

replay.detail: No replay or migration is introduced; shared projections are disposable process-local state.

schema.detail: No persistent schema, index, or schema version changes.

rules.detail: Claim retention and checkpoint rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing collection protocol, authority checks, snapshot fences, and bounded subscriber windows are retained.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: Restart or rollback discards the process-local cache; persisted claims and derived state are unchanged.
